literal_meaning: ঘরে আগুন ধরানো (sets fire to the house)
figurative_meaning_en: Someone who disturbs the peace of the home
similar_in_english: Rock the boat in the family
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় ঘর জ্বালানে, কখনো শান্তি দিতে চায় না।
বোনের বিয়ের পরও সে ঘর জ্বালানে করে চলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He always sets the house on fire, never wanting peace.
Even after the sister's wedding, she continues to disturb the home's peace.
note: The idiom metaphorically refers to creating discord in the household, often used in contexts of familial strife.
